myportability.index.lede: Your own authored content — the posts, events, projects, documents, pages, messages, and media you created — as one portable *.kumunita archive. Export it as a file, or import one of your archives back into this community. Nothing here ever carries your password, and only your own rows travel.
myportability.export_desc: One *.kumunita archive — your own authored content and media (never your password, and only your rows).
myportability.import_desc: Bring one of your *.kumunita archives back. We'll check what fits this community and what needs your call — you decide, item by item, where each piece goes.
myportability.resolve.summary_lead: Your archive was checked against this community.
myportability.resolve.summary_counts: Rows that fit and will be imported: {0}. Duplicates that already exist and will be skipped: {1}.
myportability.resolve.summary_tail: The ones below reference a group that does not exist here — you decide, one by one, where each goes.
myportability.resolve.nothing: Nothing to resolve — every row in your archive fits this community or already exists.
myportability.resolve.archive_hint: The same archive you imported above — your choices are applied to its contents.
myportability.resolve.reason: This {0} references {1} {2}, which does not exist here.
myportability.resolve.reason_unknown: A reference this row points to does not exist here.
myportability.resolve.no_groups: You have no member-of groups here — you can discard this row.
myportability.index.title: My data
